articles.title: Everything you need to know about the US midterms and what they'll mean for America | BBC Newscast
articles.titleZh: 关于美国中期选举及其对美国的意义，您需要了解的一切| BBC新闻广播
articles.summary:
The US midterm elections are set to take place on Tuesday, in a vote that could have a major impact on Donald Trump’s presidency. 

Americans will choose members of Congress, which is made up of two parts - the House of Representatives and the Senate. The Democrat Party has high expectations, but are the polls right?  

To go through how the next 48 hours might unfold, Adam is joined from Washington by chief news presenter Caitríona Perry and Stephen Hawkins, global director of research at the pollster More in Common.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: The BBC gains rare access to people inside Iran | Global News Podcast
articles.titleZh: 英国广播公司罕见地接触到伊朗境内的人|全球新闻播客
articles.summary:
BBC Panorama has gained rare access to people inside Iran - telling the inside story of how their lives have been shaped by a year of war and anti-government protests. 

In this episode, we hear from Samira, a mother whose 16-year-old daughter was killed during anti-government protests. Samira fled the country on foot, and now lives abroad in hiding. 

We also hear about the medic who received patients injured by bullets as the regime cracked down on protests. 

Months after the wave of protests swept through the country, what does dissent look like in Iran today? How has the war with the US and Israel affected opposition voices?

Iranian authorities acknowledge that more than 3,000 people were killed in the protests, but claim some were members of the security forces. 

One human rights group, Hrana, however, estimates the number of dead stands at more than 7,000 - most of them protesters. 

The Iranian embassy in London told Panorama that peaceful and legitimate protests had been hijacked by foreign powers, including the US, which promoted violence, provided weapons and equipment, and compromised public security.

00:00 Introduction
01:00 The mother who fled Iran after her daughter was killed in anti-government protests
03:19 The medic who treated injured protesters
05:26 What the US-Israel war meant for those demonstrating against the regime
09:15 What do protests in Iran look like today?
10:30 The risks for those speaking out and sharing their stories
11:15 What the Iranian authorities say about the allegations of using violence against protesters?

New episodes of the Global News Podcast are published twice a day. You can listen here: https://link.mgln.ai/GNP-YT

And you can find more of our YouTube episodes here: https://bbc.in/GlobalNewsPodcast

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#BBCNews

articles.readingTextZh:
BBC Panorama罕见地接触到了伊朗境内的人们，讲述了他们的生活是如何被一年的战争和反政府抗议活动所塑造的。

在这一集中，我们听到了Samira的故事， Samira是一位母亲，她的16岁女儿在反政府抗议活动中丧生。

萨米拉徒步逃离该国，现在躲藏在国外。

我们还听说，在政权镇压抗议活动时，有医生接待了被子弹击伤的病人。

在抗议浪潮席卷全国几个月后，今天的伊朗异议是什么样的？

与美国和以色列的战争如何影响了反对派的声音？

伊朗当局承认有3000多人在抗议活动中丧生，但声称其中一些人是安全部队的成员。

然而，人权组织Hrana估计死亡人数超过7,000人，其中大多数是抗议者。

伊朗驻伦敦大使馆告诉Panorama ，包括美国在内的外国势力劫持了和平与合法的抗议活动，这些抗议活动助长了暴力，提供了武器和设备，并危及公共安全。

articles.title: A midterm 'polling earthquake', blue TX enthusiasm, key margins & more | Enten election roundup

articles.summary:
With 1 day to go until midterms, CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten runs the numbers; from NYT's new polling on Kansas, Michigan, Texas and more to the difference between registered and likely voters.

0:00 From KS to MI, Enten weighs in on a blue wave 'polling earthquake'
3:42 TX Senate showdown: Dems' best polling since 1988
6:31 Key demographic: NYT polls among TX Latinos
8:26 Should Dems be scared ahead of midterms?
11:31 Difference between registered and likely voters
14:50 House approval heading into the midterms
18:27 Dems' paths to victory as Trump flip flops on rally plans
21:37 How many times Trump has cast doubts on elections in his 2nd term

Watch Harry’s show, 'The Enten Scale', on CNN: https://cnn.it/4rXUcHz

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#Midterms #Enten #News
